body:
Hello,

Our NuPlan submission failed during the evaluator clean-slate stage, before
the contestant image was evaluated.

Submission ID:
ee21f779-d09c-4052-a34e-da22038dee50

Image digest:
sha256:6501deb74343038b38eac0f5c1809250224471d40354cf5fb9e1f9beb722f17d

Failure code:
CLEAN_SLATE_FAILED

Failure reason:
contestant networks and DOCKER-USER iptables rules remained on the evaluator
instance.

The submission has score=null and throughput_limit=null, indicating that the
actual contestant evaluation did not run. This failure also consumed one of
our monthly submissions.

Could you please rerun this submission or restore the consumed submission
quota?

Team:
fyrian-migu

Track:
nuplan

comments.body:
Thanks for reporting this. We re-reviewed the detailed evaluator logs and found that the final CLEAN_SLATE_FAILED status was misleading: an unrelated stale network cleanup issue occurred after your run and replaced the displayed failure reason.

Your image was pulled and all contestant replicas were launched. However, before simulation began, the driver process failed to start with:
`exec /app/.venv/bin/alpasim_driver_main failed: Permission denied`

Because the driver never started, its ports never opened and the evaluator could not begin the NuPlan evaluation. The later clean-slate issue was unrelated to this startup failure; we have since corrected that cleanup problem.

Please rebuild the image with the driver executable and its entrypoint permissions corrected, then submit again.

title: [BUG]NuPlan submission failed before evaluation with CLEAN_SLATE_FAILED
